Audio never leaves your computer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-rapidspeech"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Local, offline speech-to-text for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Click the microphone in the composer, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"speak, and the recognized text is inserted into your draft — transcribed by a RapidSpeech.cpp `rs-se"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rver` running on your own machine. **Audio never leaves your computer.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Fully offline** — audio, model inference, and transcripts stay on this machine end to end.
- **M"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"anaged server** — on first use, dsh downloads the `rs-server` binary and your chosen model, verifies"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" their integrity, spawns the server on a loopback port, and reclaims it after idle time. No manual s"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ervices.
- **Model switching from the plugin page** — pick a model in the plugin's settings; it down"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"loads on the next recording and hot-swaps. Every downloaded model stays cached, so switching back is"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" instant.
- **Curated model catalog** — X-ASR, SenseVoice, and FunASR-Nano from RapidAI's official m"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"irrors (ModelScope, HuggingFace, hf-mirror), each pinned to a SHA-256.
- **Coexists with other provi"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ders** — installs beside the official SenseVoice plugin; pick a provider per recording from the voic"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"e-input selector.
- **External mode** — point the plugin at an `rs-server` you run yourself; the plu"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"gin then only connects and never manages it."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2 or newer** (npm CLI or Desktop app)
- CPU with **AVX2** — Intel Haswell ("},{"id":"p8s2","text":"2013) / AMD Excavator (2015) or newer. Both the
Linux and Windows builds target AVX2 as their baseli"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ne, so the requirement is
identical on either OS.
- Disk: ~200 MB–1 GB per model; RAM: ~1–2 GB while"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" transcribing
- Windows x64 and Linux x64"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### From the plugin marketplace (Desktop / Web UI)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Two ways — both put **RapidSpeech ASR (local)** in your plugin list:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Search and install** (simplest): open the market's install page, search for
`dsh-plugin-rapidspe"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ech`, and install it. The package lives on the official npm
registry; if your npm mirror lags behind"},{"id":"p12s3","text":", give it a few minutes or point the
registry back at `registry.npmjs.org`.
- **Index source** (cura"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ted card with a description): add this index URL in the
market's index settings, then find **RapidSp"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"eech ASR (local)** and install:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### From the CLI"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Or install a specific release artifact without any build tooling:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Installing from a git checkout"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"On pnpm ≥ 10, the first `add` from git asks you to allow the build script — add the
package key prin"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ted by pnpm to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` under `allowBuilds`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. Start dsh and open the composer.
2. Click the microphone, then **Install** when prompted — the rs"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"-server binary and the
model download in the background (one-time, ~180 MB for the default model).
3"},{"id":"p22s3","text":". Record. Stop, and the transcript appears in your draft, ready to edit and send."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The server reclaims itself after 5 idle minutes and wakes in about 2 seconds on the
next recording."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Models"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `modelId` | Size | Languages | Mirrors |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| `xasr-q8_0` *(default)* | 178 MB | auto, zh, en | ModelScope |
| `sense-voice-small-q4_k` | 182 MB"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" | auto, zh, en, yue, ja, ko | HuggingFace, hf-mirror, ModelScope |
| `funasr-nano-q4_k_m` | 692 MB "},{"id":"p26s3","text":"| auto, zh, en | HuggingFace, ModelScope |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### Switching models"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Open the plugin's page in dsh and pick a model — the field is live: the next
recording downloads it "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"(after your consent) and subsequent recordings use it.
All catalog models live in the same cache, so"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" switching back to a previously
downloaded model needs no download."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"X-ASR is only published on ModelScope, so the HuggingFace mirror is not offered
for it; choosing an "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"unavailable mirror fails explicitly rather than falling back."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Advanced overrides"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Set these in the plugin page or in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (precedence
top to bottom):"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- `modelPath` — use a local GGUF file directly.
- `modelDownloadUrl` — download from any HTTPS URL.
"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"- `modelId` — a catalog entry."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| `managementMode` | `managed` | `managed`: the plugin downloads, spawns, and reclaims its server. `"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"external`: connect to an existing rs-server at `endpoint`. |

| `modelSha256` | — | Integrity hash for a manually specified model"},{"id":"p35s6","text":". Editable live. |
